item.description:
Kipowi 0.8.2

  • Short samples can be worked on. On a clip of well under a second, marking was refused without saying so, and once one mark was made every later drag changed the level instead of marking again.
  • A level is taken hold of by the band that shows it, rather than anywhere inside the stretch it covers — so the rest of the waveform stays free to mark.
  • The shortest mark, and how far the timeline zooms, now scale with the clip instead of stopping at a flat twenty milliseconds.
  • On a clip under a second the in, out and length readouts are in milliseconds, where hundredths of a second could not tell one selection from another.
